name: Good Finance Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Good Finance Securities Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities commission agency and brokerage business in Taiwan. It operates through Client Partner, Investment, Investment bank, Futures, and All Other segments. The company is also involved in securities and bonds dealing; trading of financial instruments relating to interest rate and bills and bonds under repurchase or resale agreements; securities underwriting; futures trading agency and brokerage services; and provision of research and analysis for securities investment.
